meta.description: Registry for tracking the closure status of symbolic derivation chains for RC-001 and RC-002.

derivation_closure_classes.meaning: The derivation steps and assumptions are registered but lack explicit evidence.
Derivation steps map to validated symbolic reduction rules or evidence.
Explicit symbolic trace exists for all steps, linking operators to equivalence relations.
All steps are supported and boundary cases are classified; awaiting formal artifact.
Derivation is fully supported by a formal proof artifact satisfying all obligations.
Derivation closure is blocked by an unresolved gap or failure mode.
